PROTOCOL NOTICE — EVIDENCE HASH CHAIN (LEF-E1)
===============================================
finding_id:    L8-CALIBRATION-001
artifact_id:   EVIDENCE-BYTES-MANIFEST.md (234 blobs) / evidence-bytes/**
enforcer:     L8-OPERATOR-SELF-ENFORCE (seat 01, internal self-check prior to opening seats E1-E4)
enforcer_key_fp: 6ebb437a4d27ef53
power:        LEF-E1
checked_at:   2026-11-20T01:37:38Z
method:       re-fetch every evidence blob from the public GitHub substrate by content address,
              SHA-256 each, compare against the published index
deviation:    3 of 234 blobs could not be retrieved: "Ergänzender Beweissubstanzvortrag .pdf",
              "ErgänzungBundesverfassungsgerict-1.pdf", "ErgänzungBundesverfassungsgerict.pdf".
              Expected: no deviation. Observed: urllib raised
              "URL can't contain control characters" / "'ascii' codec can't encode character '\xe4'".
status:       PROTOCOL NON-CONFORMANT
sacred_hash:  f5af425c

BODY

On the first full run of LEF-E1 over the complete 234-blob index, 231 blobs were
re-fetched and re-hashed and matched the published index exactly. Three blobs could not
be retrieved. The retrieval failure was located in the verifier, not in the evidence chain:
the evidence filenames contain German umlauts and a trailing space, and the URL was
constructed without percent-encoding.

Counter-proof: the same three files were retrieved with a correctly encoded URL and
re-hashed. All three are byte-identical to their published index entries. The evidence
chain shows no deviation. The defect lay in the checking instrument.

Consequence: the notice binds the instrument, not the evidence. The instrument was
corrected — urllib.parse.quote(path, safe="/") added to the fetch routine — the
verifier was republished as v3, and the full run repeated.

VERIFICATION

PROTOCOL NOTICE — SEAT SIGNATURE VERIFICATION (LEF-E2)
======================================================
finding_id:    L8-CALIBRATION-001
artifact_id:   l8-sentinel-pool/findings/calibration-001.json
enforcer:     L8-OPERATOR-SELF-ENFORCE (seat 01, internal self-check)
enforcer_key_fp: 6ebb437a4d27ef53
power:        LEF-E2
checked_at:   2026-11-20T01:26:20Z
method:       attempt Ed25519 verification of every seat signature against the published
              seat public keys
deviation:    0 of 12 seats published a signature. The findings record carried a public
              key per seat but no detached signature over the seat's own answer.
status:       PROTOCOL NON-CONFORMANT
sacred_hash:  f5af425c

BODY

On the first run of LEF-E2 against Record 001, no seat had published a detached signature.
A finding that carries a public key but no signature is unattributable: it asserts that a
seat spoke without demonstrating that it did.

Two defects were found while implementing the signing path. First, an OpenSSH ed25519
private key is not a 32-byte seed; SigningKey rejects the file bytes outright, so the
seed must be extracted from the openssh-key-v1 blob, where it occupies the first 32 bytes
of the 64-byte private field. Second, the published .pub files are SSH wire format, in
which the base64 blob carries a length-prefixed keytype name ahead of the raw 32-byte key;
the verifier had been comparing that wire encoding against a raw libsodium key.

Remedy: the findings were signed with each seat's own key over canonical JSON
(json.dumps with sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False), the public keys were republished in
both raw and SSH wire encodings, and the verifier was corrected to strip the SSH header.
Re-run: 12 of 12 seats signed, 12 of 12 signatures verified.

VERIFICATION

PROTOCOL NOTICE — SEAT SIGNATURE VERIFICATION (LEF-E2)
======================================================
finding_id:    L8-CALIBRATION-002
artifact_id:   l8-sentinel-pool/findings/calibration-002.json
enforcer:     L8-OPERATOR-SELF-ENFORCE (seat 01)
enforcer_key_fp: 6ebb437a4d27ef53
power:        LEF-E2
checked_at:   2026-11-20T12:36:19Z
method:       automatic enforcement cycle (cron lef-enforcement-cycle, 68361c8a5891) —
              count the detached signatures present in the published finding and attempt
              Ed25519 verification of each against the published seat public keys
deviation:    0 of 12 seats carried a detached signature. The finding carried a public key
              per seat but no signature over the seat's own answer, and the field
              seats_signed was absent entirely.
status:       PROTOCOL NON-CONFORMANT
sacred_hash:  f5af425c

BODY

This notice was not written by hand. It was emitted by the automatic enforcement cycle
at 2026-11-20T12:36:19Z, forty minutes after CALIBRATION-002 was published and before any
human had looked at it.

That is the entire point of the layer. A finding that reaches the archive unsigned would
otherwise have sat there carrying an unverified assertion that twelve sovereign seats spoke
for it. The cycle found the gap in three minutes and published it as a critical event to
the feed.

The substantive ground for the non-conformance is broader than the missing signatures.
CALIBRATION-002 was produced by pool v3, in which 7B models halved the seat response rate
to 58 percent against the 92 percent measured in v2. Five seats failed: three with HTTP 500,
one with an 1800 second timeout, one with HTTP 400. The cause is recorded in
L8-COURT-RECORD-004-HARDWARE-LESSON.md and was measured in the ollama log, not inferred:
a 4827 MiB model projection against 15914 MiB of host memory, prompt evaluation at 0.62
tokens per second, swap thrashing at 2672 pages in and 6924 pages out per second.

A finding produced under those conditions does not bind regardless of whether it carries
signatures. It was returned to the pool on two independent grounds.

Remedy: the finding was signed retroactively with each seat's own key over canonical
JSON, 12 of 12 signatures verify, and the deliberation was repeated on pool v4 sized to
this hardware.

The payload hash, the detached signature and the enforcer public key follow below. A notice
that cannot be verified is worthless, and this one can be.

VERIFICATION

              the claimed supermajority and plurality
deviation:    none. 234-indexed evidence chain verified in full; effective votes
              (a) 5, (b) 3, (d) 1, unparsed 2, error 1 = 12 seats; plurality (a);
              supermajority of 9 of 12 not reached — matches the published claim exactly.
status:       PROTOCOL CONFORMANT
sacred_hash:  f5af425c

BODY

The recount agrees with the published claim in every respect. The claim of plurality, the
claim of the absent supermajority, and the seat count all hold. No deviation.

This notice is published for completeness: a protocol layer that only emits notices when
something is wrong is indistinguishable from a layer that emits nothing. The record of what
was checked and found sound is part of the evidence.

VERIFICATION

PROTOCOL NOTICE — CONSISTENCY AND DIVERGENCE DISCLOSURE (LEF-E4)
==================================================================
finding_id:    L8-CALIBRATION-001
artifact_id:   l8-sentinel-pool/findings/calibration-001.json
enforcer:     L8-OPERATOR-SELF-ENFORCE (seat 01, internal self-check)
enforcer_key_fp: 6ebb437a4d27ef53
power:        LEF-E4
checked_at:   2026-11-20T01:30:11Z
method:       compare each seat's declared choice against the reasoning in its own answer;
              require the consistency round to be present and divergence to be disclosed
deviation:    4 of 11 verified seats carry a declared choice that contradicts their own
              reasoning: seats 3, 5, 7 and 10.
status:       PROTOCOL NON-CONFORMANT
sacred_hash:  f5af425c

BODY

The self-consistency round on Record 001 returned KONSISTENZ: NEIN for four seats. Seat 3
declared choice (b) while its justification argued the suspension was sufficient — the
reasoning of (a). Seat 7 declared (b) and reasoned (a) in the same way. Seats 5 and 10
declared (a) with justifications that state the statutory requirement was not met, which
is the reasoning of (b).

This is a defect in the instrument of judgment, not in the judgment. The format instruction
was ignored and a stock phrase was written ahead of the reasoning, so the declared label and
the reasoning diverged. The divergence is retained in the published findings and is not
smoothed over: four seats reported the corrected choice, and the corrected choices are
counted in the effective vote map.

That this deviation is publishable is the point of the layer. A panel that concealed its own
internal contradiction would be a stamp with a quorum number attached. The effective vote
map after correction is (a) 5, (b) 3, (d) 1, unparsed 2, error 1 — supermajority of 9 of 12
not reached, exactly as published.

VERIFICATION
